summary: KOA's page and booking form: open year-round, 50-amp full hookups and water/electric, pull-throughs to 70 ft, Wi-Fi/cable/pool, 27-night max. Fees widened $50-115 -> $35-150: an off-season weeknight water/electric site quotes $35, a Saturday $71 base and $150 Patio site. Laundry, showers and camp store appear only in camper reviews, not written. Military discount (Good Sam directory) not stated by KOA; left as recorded.
flags: Price gate (private, US$50): the base is $35 on an off-season weeknight, $50 on a May weeknight and $71 on a November Saturday, so weekend and season nights exceed $50; but the campground is 34 km from the Richmond metro gateway (gateways.py), inside the 40 km exception. No action needed unless the gateway exception should not apply.
